positive: Of the 23 users who came back, 7 (30%) got an improvement plan. Of the 1005 who came only once, 74 (7%) did. Returning users were about 4 times as likely to get a plan.
During school hours (9 AM to 5 PM): 78.2% of messages. The busiest hour is 12 PM to 1 PM, with 19.2% of all messages.
Outside school hours: 14.5% of messages come between 6 PM and 7 AM, so teachers also use Saathi from home. The remaining 7.3% come just before or after school (7 to 9 AM, 5 to 6 PM).
School heads are the most plan-driven users: 21 of 145 school heads (14.5%) got an improvement plan, against 59 of 694 teachers (8.5%).
Saathi reached users in 37 of Bihar's 38 districts.
70.9% of users chose Hindi, and 10.8% of messages in Hindi are voice, compared with 4.3% in English.
The most common real ask is school or classroom improvement: 73 of 170 education questions (42.9%).
In a typical conversation, the first answer comes within 1 minute of asking.
When users come back on another day, most bring a new question: 20 of 23 returning users (87%). The rest continue earlier work, such as downloading a plan.
